items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I'd done some work for Billy Eckstine, you know, some conducting and album work with him.

ctx.x: And Al laughs about it now, you know. And there was another time when we were doing a tour. They used to call them Birdland tours. And they had a -- Count Basie, I was working with Sarah Vaughan at that time, and Billy Eckstine. Billy's got a heart as big as an oak tree, but he's got some funny humor, you know? He used to take Al walking and walk him into a wall.
